name: hatch-emergence
notes: The carrier's launched gargoyles in their one-shot emergence poses (openspec/changes/hatch-emergence design §3, plan/render-runs/hatch-emergence.md). GENERATED by tools/rigkit/families/hatch_emergence.lua: edit that and rerun. Units are finished texels at texel 1.0 (= combat-atlas pixels, drawn at 40/64 arena units each). Frame: x screen right, y away from the player, z up out of the deck; the origin is the hatch rim's centre and the rim plane is z = 0. The rest pose (flare) stands on the rim, wings spread toward the camera, so the hero paint reaches every part. One skeleton for every species, so the key poses are shared.

grade.notes: rigsheet pose finish: the 12:1 area scale averages the paint's own outlines into mud, so lift it before the palette snap

articulation.notes: Named key poses (rigkit keyposes): one rigid op list per slot, children follow their parents. Order = atlas columns; the runtime names them in lib/game/hatch_emergence_atlas.dart.

plate.notes: steel pauldrons, bracers, breastplate and horn caps (the violet brute)

gilt.notes: the gold elder's crown, breastplate and finger bones

horn.notes: horns, fangs and the beard: ivory bone

eye.notes: glowing eyes (on the creature only, never in the hatch)

palettes.notes: The combat atlas's gargoyle ramps (plan/sprite-atlas.md, Palette), so the emergence frames match the flight frames they hand off to.

violet.title: Violet brute
violet.notes: armoured brute: massive steel pauldrons, small head sunk between them, short thick metal-capped horns, heavy fists, stubby broad wings, thick tail

coral.title: Coral hunter
coral.notes: predatory hunter: sleek, head thrust forward on long jaws, very long swept-back horns, the longest and narrowest wings, a long whip tail with a stinger

gold.title: Gold elder
gold.notes: crowned elder: a three-tined gold crown with a ruby over back-swept ram horns, a forked beard, broad ornate wings with gold finger bones, a gold breastplate with a ruby, an orb in each claw

prompts.hero: Repaint this clay model as a finished, detailed painted game sprite of a small demonic gargoyle creature standing with its bat wings spread wide, seen from the front and above, in the style of a high-resolution 16-bit fantasy arcade sprite painting. Stony, leathery hide with heavy shoulders and a hunched torso, clawed hands and feet with ivory claws, a barbed tail, bat-wing membranes stretched between bony fingers with torn, scalloped trailing edges, small glowing yellow eyes. Keep each part's colour exactly as the clay shows it: the hide, belly, membranes, ivory horns and claws. Crisp edge highlights, lit from the upper left, readable at small size. Keep the outline, every shape, the pose and the viewing angle exactly. Solid flat green background (#00FF00), no checkerboard, no shadow.
prompts.hero_notes: The prompt is hero, then hero_<species>, then negative (one job per species, seeds 90N0000).
prompts.hero_violet: A violet-purple armoured brute with massive blue-steel pauldrons and breastplate, a small head sunk between them, short thick steel-capped horns, heavy fists, stubby broad dark purple wings.
prompts.hero_coral: A coral-red predatory hunter, sleek, head thrust forward on long jaws, very long swept-back ivory horns, long narrow dark crimson wings, a whip tail with a stinger.
prompts.hero_gold: A golden-ochre crowned elder with a three-tined gold crown set with a ruby over back-swept ivory ram horns, a forked beard, a gold breastplate with a ruby, gold finger bones in broad brown wings, a glowing amber orb in each claw.
prompts.negative: human, person, angel, bird, feathers, armour plates on the wings, text, letters, watermark, logo, frame, border, blurry, photo, multiple views, grid, background scene, checkerboard, shadow, cartoon, chibi, toy, extra limbs, extra heads, extra eyes

selected.notes: Picked raws (paths under root); ledger plan/render-runs/hatch-emergence.md. register bbox: the hero control was cropped around the subject, so each raw is registered to the clay silhouette box.
